"""Real browser and BCC UI, fixture API responses: not owner/local-model acceptance."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import pytest
from .test_ux2_thinking_pane import live, _login
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright, expect

def launch(pw):
    path=os.environ.get('BOSSMAN_TEST_CHROMIUM')
    return pw.chromium.launch(**({'executable_path':path} if path else {}))

def test_home_selects_one_of_multiple_agents_and_blocks_double_submit(live):
    with sync_playwright() as pw:
        browser=launch(pw); page=browser.new_page()
        page.route('**/api/agents', lambda r:r.fulfill(json=[{'id':11,'name':'Первый'}, {'id':22,'name':'Второй'}]))
        _login(page,live)
        page.goto(live.url+'/#/home-v3')
        choice=page.get_by_role('combobox',name='Агент для задачи');expect(choice).to_be_visible()
        choice.select_option('22')
        pending=[]
        def capture(route):
            if route.request.method=='POST': pending.append(route)
            else:route.continue_()
        page.route('**/api/tasks',capture)
        input=page.locator('.bx-command-input');input.fill('Контрольная заметка без внешней отправки')
        # The video-intent preflight is asynchronous. Await the actual task POST,
        # not a guessed 30 ms after click. Hold its response while testing dedup.
        with page.expect_request(lambda r: r.method == 'POST' and r.url.endswith('/api/tasks'), timeout=15000):
            page.locator('.bx-command button.bx-btn-primary').click()
        expect(page.locator('.bx-command button.bx-btn-primary')).to_be_disabled()
        input.press('Control+Enter')
        page.evaluate('() => Promise.resolve()')
        assert len(pending)==1
        assert pending[0].request.post_data_json['agent_id']==22
        pending[0].fulfill(json={'id':44,'status':'queued'})
        browser.close()

def test_failed_attention_fetches_never_render_calm_or_idle(live):
    with sync_playwright() as pw:
        browser=launch(pw);page=browser.new_page()
        _login(page,live)
        for pattern in ['**/api/approvals*','**/api/missions*','**/api/tasks*']:
            page.route(pattern,lambda r:r.fulfill(status=503,json={'detail':'fixture unavailable'}))
        page.goto(live.url+'/#/home-v3')
        expect(page.locator('#attention[role="alert"]')).to_be_visible()
        assert page.locator('#attention.is-calm').count()==0
        expect(page.locator('#now-card')).to_have_attribute('data-status','unknown')
        assert 'Ничего не ждёт вашего решения' not in page.locator('#attention').inner_text()
        browser.close()

def test_unwired_team_mode_is_disabled(live):
    with sync_playwright() as pw:
        browser=launch(pw);page=browser.new_page();_login(page,live)
        page.goto(live.url+'/#/home-v3')
        expect(page.get_by_role('button',name='С агентами',exact=True)).to_be_disabled()
        browser.close()

"""Audit P0: the shared contracts ship in the wheels. Builds bossman-shared and
bossman-core wheels, installs them into a fresh venv (no deps) and imports them
from a directory that is NOT the repository, so no checkout path can leak in."""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import subprocess
import sys
import venv
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
pytestmark = pytest.mark.timeout(600)


def _run(cmd, cwd=None, env=None):
    return subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=str(cwd or ROOT), env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=540)


def test_installed_wheels_resolve_shared_contracts_without_the_checkout(tmp_path):
    # Clean every build/install/probe boundary: inherited PYTHONPATH can make
    # pip see source-tree egg-info as already installed in a fresh interpreter.
    env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k not in ("PYTHONPATH", "PYTHONHOME")}
    wheels = tmp_path / "wheels"
    for src in (ROOT, ROOT / "bossman-core"):
        r = _run([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "wheel", "--no-deps", "-q", "-w", str(wheels), str(src)], cwd=tmp_path, env=env)
        assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr[-2000:]
    built = sorted(p.name for p in wheels.glob("*.whl"))
    assert any(n.startswith("bossman_shared-") for n in built) and any(n.startswith("bossman_core-") for n in built), built
    venv.EnvBuilder(with_pip=False, clear=True).create(tmp_path / "venv")
    py = tmp_path / "venv" / ("Scripts/python.exe" if os.name == "nt" else "bin/python")
    r = _run([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "--python", str(py), "install", "-q", "--no-deps", "--force-reinstall", *map(str, wheels.glob("*.whl"))], cwd=tmp_path, env=env)
    assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr[-2000:]
    probe = ("import bossman_shared.cache_observation as co, learning.trace as lt, bossman_schemas, json, pathlib;"
             "import bossman._shared as s; assert s.AVAILABLE, 'bossman._shared degraded';"
             "assert lt.SCHEMA_PATH.exists(), lt.SCHEMA_PATH;"
             "print(lt.SCHEMA_PATH, pathlib.Path(bossman_schemas.__path__[0]).exists())")
    r = _run([str(py), "-c", probe], cwd=tmp_path, env=env)
    assert r.returncode == 0, (r.stdout[-1000:], r.stderr[-2000:])
    assert "site-packages" in r.stdout and str(ROOT) not in r.stdout
